info.name: Numark NV (BiteDJ Pi4 Test v0.3)
info.author: Hidetsugu Takahashi; BiteDJ test mapping contributors
info.description: Experimental original NV: mixer, transport, pitch, jog, pads and browse. LCDs, advanced FX, touch-EQ and Slicer are not implemented. See installed bitedj-nv-test documentation.
